title: Kāśīpañcakam
subtitle: Five verses on Kāśī as the Self

source.edition: The Works of Sri Sankaracharya, vol. 18, Sri Vani Vilas Press, 1910
source.digitalText: Ambuda CC0 1.0; machine-readable text credit: Arun Prasad

units.label: Verse 1
units.deva:
मनो निवृत्तिः परमोपशान्तिः सा तीर्थवर्या मणिकर्णिका च ।
ज्ञानप्रवाहा विमलादिगङ्गा सा काशिकाहं निजबोधरूपा ॥
units.translation: The mind’s withdrawal is supreme peace; that is the finest sacred bathing place, Maṇikarṇikā. The stream of knowledge is the pure, primordial Ganges; that Kāśī am I, of the nature of self-knowledge.

gloss.en: of the nature of one’s own knowledge

units.iast:
mano nivṛttiḥ paramopaśāntiḥ sā tīrthavaryā maṇikarṇikā ca |
jñānapravāhā vimalādigaṅgā sā kāśikāhaṃ nijabodharūpā ||

units.label: Verse 2
units.deva:
यस्यामिदं कल्पितमिन्द्रजालं चराचरं भाति मनोविलासम् ।
सच्चित्सुखैका परमात्मरूपा सा काशिकाहं निजबोधरूपा ॥
units.translation: In that Kāśī, this conjurer’s show—the moving and unmoving world—shines as a play of mind. She is one, of the nature of being, consciousness, and bliss, and is the supreme Self. That Kāśī am I, of the nature of self-knowledge.

gloss.en: of the nature of the supreme Self

units.iast:
yasyāmidaṃ kalpitamindrajālaṃ carācaraṃ bhāti manovilāsam |
saccitsukhaikā paramātmarūpā sā kāśikāhaṃ nijabodharūpā ||

units.label: Verse 3
units.deva:
कोशेषु पञ्चस्वधिराजमाना बुद्धिर्भवानी प्रतिदेहगेहम् ।
साक्षी शिवः सर्वगतोऽन्तरात्मा सा काशिकाहं निजबोधरूपा ॥
units.translation: The intellect, reigning in the five sheaths in every bodily dwelling, is Bhavānī; Śiva is the witness, the all-pervading inner Self. That Kāśī am I, of the nature of self-knowledge.

gloss.en: in each house that is a body

units.iast:
kośeṣu pañcasvadhirājamānā buddhirbhavānī pratidehageham |
sākṣī śivaḥ sarvagato’ntarātmā sā kāśikāhaṃ nijabodharūpā ||

units.label: Verse 4
units.deva:
काश्यां हि काशते काशी काशी सर्वप्रकाशिका ।
सा काशी विदिता येन तेन प्राप्ता हि काशिका ॥
units.translation: In Kāśī, Kāśī indeed shines; Kāśī illumines everything. Whoever knows that Kāśī has truly attained Kāśī.
units.iast:
kāśyāṃ hi kāśate kāśī kāśī sarvaprakāśikā |
sā kāśī viditā yena tena prāptā hi kāśikā ||

units.label: Verse 5
units.deva:
काशीक्षेत्रं शरीरं त्रिभुवनजननी व्यापिनी ज्ञानगङ्गा भक्तिः श्रद्धा गयेयं निजगुरुचरणध्यानयोगः प्रयागः ।
विश्वेशोऽयं तुरीयं सकलजनमनःसाक्षिभूतोऽन्तरात्मा देहे सर्वं मदीये यदि वसति पुनस्तीर्थमन्यत्किमस्ति ॥
units.translation: The body is the sacred field of Kāśī; the all-pervading mother of the three worlds is the Ganges of knowledge. Devotion and faith are Gayā; meditation on the feet of one’s own teacher is Prayāga. The Lord of the universe is this fourth state, the inner Self who witnesses the minds of all people. If all this abides in my body, what other pilgrimage place is there?

gloss.en: union through meditation on one’s own teacher’s feet
become the witness of the minds of all people

gloss.sa: यदि • पुनः • अन्यत् • तीर्थम् • किम् • अस्ति
gloss.en: if • then • another • pilgrimage place • what • is there

units.iast:
kāśīkṣetraṃ śarīraṃ tribhuvanajananī vyāpinī jñānagaṅgā bhaktiḥ śraddhā gayeyaṃ nijagurucaraṇadhyānayogaḥ prayāgaḥ |
viśveśo’yaṃ turīyaṃ sakalajanamanaḥsākṣibhūto’ntarātmā dehe sarvaṃ madīye yadi vasati punastīrthamanyatkimasti ||

units.label: Closing colophon
units.deva: इति श्रीमत्परमहंसपरिव्राजकाचार्यस्य श्रीगोविन्दभगवत्पूज्यपादशिष्यस्य श्रीमच्छङ्करभगवतः कृतौ काशीपञ्चकं संपूर्णम् ॥
units.translation: Thus is completed the Kāśīpañcakam composed by the revered Śaṅkara Bhagavat, disciple of the venerable Govinda Bhagavat, the revered teacher who has renounced all, and supreme among wandering ascetics.

gloss.en: whose feet are worthy of worship

units.iast: iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryasya śrīgovindabhagavatpūjyapādaśiṣyasya śrīmacchaṅkarabhagavataḥ kṛtau kāśīpañcakaṃ saṃpūrṇam ||
